title: 钽矿采购复检、暂定结算与收款账户变更的三重压力
english: Tantalum assay, provisional settlement and beneficiary-change pressure

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 8分钟：慢读三遍，注意 concession、conditional、reconcile 的重音。
lines: Conditional acceptance
有条件验收
Counteroffer
还价
Reconciliation
核对一致
Nonconforming lot
不合格批次
Escalation
升级处理
Documentary evidence
书面证据

modules.title: 10个高频词组
modules.hint: 6分钟：遮住中文说含义，再用英文造句。
lines: Price validity period
报价有效期
Assay tolerance
化验容差
Retention sample
留样
Provisional invoice
暂估发票
Final settlement
最终结算
Beneficial owner
最终受益所有人
Proof of origin
原产地证明材料
Chain-of-custody log
交接链日志
Loading authorization
装车授权
Disputed balance
争议余额

modules.title: 10个核心句
modules.hint: 8分钟：先逐句朗读，再用不同语气重说。
lines: Our offer is valid until noon Kigali time.
我方报价有效期至基加利时间中午十二点。
We cannot accept an assay result without a traceable sample.
没有可追溯样品，我们无法接受化验结果。
Please distinguish the dry weight from the gross weight.
请区分干重和毛重。
The revised price is conditional on independent verification.
修订价格以独立核验为条件。
We need a signed record of the sampling procedure.
我们需要签字确认的取样程序记录。
Do not change the beneficiary details by email alone.
不能仅凭邮件修改收款人信息。
The truck may wait, but the cargo must not be released.
车辆可以等待，但货物不得放行。
Please reconcile the invoice with the packing list.
请核对发票与装箱单是否一致。
We can discuss the undisputed portion separately.
我们可以单独讨论无争议部分。
I will confirm the decision in writing after compliance review.
合规审查后我会书面确认决定。

modules.title: 金额吨位品位汇率口述
modules.hint: 6分钟：均为虚构练习数字；说出单位、换算和限制条件。
lines: The gross weight is fourteen point eight metric tonnes.
模拟毛重为14.8公吨。
Moisture is six percent, giving a dry weight of thirteen point nine one two tonnes.
模拟含水率6%，干重为13.912吨。
The initial assay is twenty-seven point six percent tantalum pentoxide.
初检五氧化二钽品位为27.6%。
The supplier claims twenty-nine point one percent.
供应商主张品位为29.1%。
The gap is one point five percentage points.
差异为1.5个百分点。
Our illustrative quote is four dollars and sixty cents per MKU.
模拟报价为每MKU 4.60美元。
For this exercise, one dollar equals one thousand four hundred and eighty francs.
本练习假设1美元兑换1480卢旺达法郎。
A provisional amount of twelve thousand dollars equals seventeen million seven hundred and sixty thousand francs at that rate.
按该假设汇率，12000美元暂估款等于1776万卢旺达法郎。

modules.title: Shadowing
modules.hint: 5分钟：跟读五轮，练习停顿和强调条件。
lines: We value our partnership, but the grade discrepancy must be resolved before final settlement.
我们重视合作，但品位差异必须在最终结算前解决。
We can arrange witnessed resampling today, preserve the original seals, and appoint an independent laboratory.
我们今天可以安排见证复采、保留原封签并指定独立实验室。
Until written clearance is issued, logistics will hold the lot and finance will hold the disputed balance.
在取得书面放行前，物流将暂扣该批货物，财务将暂缓争议款项。
Please confirm the revised timeline so all teams work from the same instructions.
请确认修订时间表，以便所有团队遵循一致指令。

modules.title: Small Talk
lines: Did your team have a smooth journey to the warehouse?
你们团队到仓库的路程顺利吗？
Yes, apart from some rain near the site.
顺利，除了矿区附近下了些雨。
Would you like some water before we review the documents?
核对文件前要喝点水吗？
Thank you. I would also appreciate a copy of the sample register.
谢谢。我也希望拿到一份样品登记表。
Of course. Let us review the records together.
当然，我们一起核对记录吧。

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 6分钟：练习商业让步与合规底线同时表达。
lines: The seller requests the higher grade for the entire lot, although the laboratory reports conflict.
虽然实验室报告冲突，卖方仍要求整批按较高品位结算。
We can consider a provisional price, but it must be documented as non-final.
我们可以考虑暂定价格，但必须书面注明不是最终价格。
Please identify the sampling date, sample seal, laboratory method and witness for each result.
请说明每份结果的取样日期、样品封签、化验方法及见证人。
If the independent assay falls outside the agreed tolerance, both parties will follow the contract's dispute mechanism.
若独立化验超出约定容差，双方将依合同争议机制处理。
Any commercial concession requires an approved amendment, not an informal message.
任何商业让步都需要获批补充协议，不能仅靠非正式消息。
We should separate the technical disagreement from the payment authorization decision.
我们应把技术争议与付款授权决定分开。

modules.title: 运输押运与海关
modules.hint: 5分钟：给出可执行指令，防止单证不符货物提前放行。
lines: Please park the vehicle in the designated secure loading area.
请将车辆停在指定安全装货区。
Check the bag count against the packing list before loading.
装车前对照装箱单核对袋数。
Record the original seal number and photograph any replacement seal under authorization.
记录原封签号，并在获授权更换封签时拍照。
The customs declaration must match the verified shipment description and quantity.
海关申报须与核实的货物描述和数量一致。
Do not backdate the handover or alter the weighing ticket.
不得倒签交接记录或篡改地磅单。
Ask the escort officer to acknowledge the hold instruction in writing.
请押运员书面确认暂缓放行指令。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 15分钟：三轮各五分钟。每轮先读情境，脱稿回答，再对照示范。
lines: Decision one: The seller demands immediate payment at the higher grade or threatens to sell elsewhere.
决策一：卖方要求立即按较高品位付款，否则转售他人。
Model answer: We respect your deadline, but the grade remains disputed. We can arrange independent testing today and discuss only the undisputed amount under our contract.
示范回答：我们尊重您的期限，但品位仍有争议。今天可以安排独立化验，并仅依合同讨论无争议金额。
Decision two: A manager asks you to approve a new bank account based on an urgent messaging-app request.
决策二：经理要求你根据即时通信软件的紧急消息批准新银行账户。
Model answer: I cannot approve a beneficiary change through chat. Please submit signed documents and complete independent callback and KYC checks.
示范回答：我不能通过聊天记录批准收款人变更。请提交签署文件，并完成独立电话回拨及KYC核验。
Decision three: The driver says customs closing time is near and asks to leave before the packing list is corrected.
决策三：司机称海关即将截止，要求装箱单更正前先发车。
Model answer: The shipment will remain secured until the packing list and declaration agree. Please notify the buyer of the revised departure time.
示范回答：在装箱单与申报一致前，货物必须保持安全管控。请通知买方修订后的发车时间。
Follow-up challenge: The supplier offers a discount if you waive the witness requirement.
追加压力：供应商提出折扣，条件是免除见证取样。
Model answer: A discount cannot replace evidence. We can negotiate price after the sampling controls are satisfied.
示范回答：折扣不能代替证据。取样控制满足后，我们可以再谈价格。
Follow-up challenge: Finance wants to pay before the bank cut-off to avoid a penalty.
追加压力：财务希望赶在银行截止前付款以避免罚金。
Model answer: We should document the commercial impact, but never bypass beneficiary verification or approval limits.
示范回答：应记录商业影响，但绝不能绕过收款人核验或审批权限。

modules.title: 5句听写
modules.hint: 4分钟：先听后写，再核对英文拼写。
lines: The price is subject to independent assay.
价格以独立化验为条件。
Please retain the original sealed sample.
请保留原始封存样品。
The invoice and packing list do not match.
发票与装箱单不一致。
We cannot authorize a new beneficiary yet.
我们尚不能授权新的收款人。
The shipment remains on hold pending written clearance.
在取得书面放行前，货物继续暂缓放行。

modules.title: 5道口语题
modules.hint: 4分钟：每题30至45秒，回答包含立场、原因和下一步。
lines: How would you explain the difference between percentage points and percent?
如何解释百分点与百分比的区别？
Which documents would you request before accepting a revised assay?
接受修订化验结果前你会索取哪些文件？
How would you negotiate a temporary price without waiving contractual rights?
如何在不放弃合同权利的前提下协商暂定价格？
What would you say if a colleague asked you to bypass KYC checks?
如果同事要求绕过KYC核验，你会怎么说？
How would you instruct an escort team to hold a shipment safely?
你会如何指示押运团队安全暂扣货物？

modules.title: 近期知识复习
modules.hint: 2分钟：连接前几课的合规与交付表达。
lines: A seal discrepancy requires photographs and a written exception report.
封签差异需要照片和书面异常报告。
A moisture discrepancy changes the dry-weight basis of settlement.
含水率差异会改变结算干重基数。
A beneficiary change requires independent verification before payment.
收款人变更需要在付款前独立核验。
A customs document must not be backdated to meet a deadline.
不得为了赶期限而倒签海关文件。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 6分钟：先朗读，再用自己的话做90秒管理汇报。
lines: Good morning. I am reporting a procurement and export readiness issue involving one fictional tantalum lot.
早上好。我汇报一批虚构钽矿的采购与出口准备问题。
The supplier's assay differs from our initial result by one point five percentage points.
供应商化验结果与我方初检相差1.5个百分点。
We have preserved the original samples and requested a witnessed resampling procedure.
我们已保存原样并要求见证重新取样。
The proposed settlement price remains provisional until the agreed verification is complete.
在约定核验完成前，拟定结算价格仍为暂定。
Separately, finance has received an unverified request to change the beneficiary account.
此外，财务收到一项未经核验的收款账户变更请求。
We will not authorize that change without signed evidence, independent confirmation and KYC approval.
没有签署证据、独立确认及KYC批准，我们不会授权变更。
Logistics has been instructed to reconcile the packing list and customs declaration before release.
已指示物流在放行前核对装箱单和海关申报。
The escort team will maintain custody of the lot and document every seal and handover.
押运团队将持续监管该批货物并记录每次封签和交接。
Our next update will include the independent assay schedule, approved payment status and revised departure plan.
下一次更新将包括独立化验安排、付款审批状态和修订发运计划。
We aim to protect the commercial relationship without compromising traceability, accuracy or compliance.
我们的目标是在不牺牲溯源、准确性和合规性的前提下维护商业关系。

modules.title: 完成清单
lines: I can pronounce five difficult procurement terms clearly.
我能清楚读出五个困难采购术语。
I can use ten core sentences without reading.
我能脱稿使用十个核心句。
I can explain grade, moisture, dry weight and currency figures.
我能说明品位、水分、干重和汇率数字。
I completed all three pressure decisions with compliant model responses.
我已完成三个高压决策并练习合规示范回答。
I can deliver the final briefing in ninety seconds.
我能在90秒内完成最终工作汇报。
